title: Don't carry cash in GTA 6
yt_title: Stop carrying cash in GTA 6 💸 (money tips that actually work)
description: GTA 6 money tips, confirmed by GamesRadar, GameSpot and PC Gamer: pocket cash is lost if you get Wasted or Busted, so deposit it at ATMs into your BuckMe account. Bank cash carries dye packs: get a Dye Pack Jammer before bank jobs pay. Fastest money per the big guides: robberies (stores first, then banks) and selling stolen cars and goods. Pocket cash is reportedly capped at $20,000 (GamesRadar only, unconfirmed). Where do you keep your cash?
